items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Well, when I worked with Claud's band, it was bad enough. I mean we played theaters...

ctx.x: Orlando Robertson. Came back and as the people heard, he was back with Claud (snap, snap, snap) Claud's offers start -- got swamped with -- we want Claud. We want Claud and Orlando, mainly, since he was back.
